# HL7 FHIR R4 Declarative `TestScript` Conformance Corpus

The declarative HL7 FHIR R4 `TestScript` resources in this directory conform to the
HL7 FHIR R4 Testing Framework (`http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/testing.html` and
`http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/testscript.html`) and AEGIS Touchstone conventions.
